### **Trial conduct interface in action**

![](gifs/conduct_interface.gif){width="1100"}

The interface has the following features:

- **Box A (top-left)** - Trial design features
- **Box B (top-right)** - Participant baseline characteristics
- **Box C (bottom-left)** - Summary statistics
- **Box D (bottom-right)** - Attrition risk over time

### **Trial design features**

**Box A** displays the inputs for trial design features. Most features have a default value set upon opening the interface, but these can be changed by selecting the other available options for a feature.

The available set of trial design inputs are:

```{r echo = FALSE}
conduct_inputs <- dplyr::tibble(
  Features = c(
    "Duration", "Number of arms", "Sample size", "Estimated sample size",
    "Age limits", "BMI limits", "eGFR limits", "Phase", "
    Number of primary outcomes (POMs)", "Comparators",
    "Blinding type", "WHO regions involved"
  ),
  Description = c(
    "Duration of trial follow-up in weeks", "Number of treatment arms",
    "Approximate sample size", "Fine-tuning of sample size",
    "Upper and lower age limits", "Upper and lower BMI limits",
    "Upper and lower estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) limits",
    "Trial phase", "Number of primary outcomes", "Comparator treatment groups",
    "Level of blinding", "World Health Organisation (WHO) regions involved"
  ),
  `Categories and limits` = c(
    "12 to 520 weeks", "2 to 6 arms", 
    "Small (<500), Medium (500 - 999), Large (>=1000)",
    "Optional input, default is midpoint of category (e.g. 250 if small)",
    "Upper: 70yr, >70yrs; Lower: 18yrs, >18yrs",
    "Upper: None, <45kg/m2; Lower: None, <=25kg/m2",
    "Upper: None, <=60 or >60ml/min/1.73m2; Lower: None, <=30 or >30ml/min/1.73m2",
    "Phase 3 or 4", "1 or >1", "Placebo, Active comparator or both",
    "Open label, Double, Triple or Quadruple",
    "Can select more than one of the following: African, the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean, Europe, South-east Asia, Western Pacific"
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  conduct_inputs,
  align = c("l", "l", "l")
) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "bordered"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    fixed_thead = TRUE,
    font_size = 16,
    position = "left"
  )
```

### **Participant baseline characteristics**

**Box B** displays the inputs for participant baseline characteristics:

```{r echo = FALSE}
conduct_inputs <- dplyr::tibble(
  Features = c(
    "Age", "Sex", "Race", "Current smoker",
    "Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) duration", 
    "Glycosylated haemoglobin (HbA1c)", 
    "Estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR)", "BMI", 
    "HDL cholesterol", "Total cholesterol", "Systolic blood pressure (BP)",
    "Number of comorbidities", "Number of concomitant medications"
  ),
  Description = c(
    "Age in years", "Is the participant female or male?",
    "Which racial group does the participant identify with?",
    "Does the participant currently smoke?", 
    "Number of years since the participant was diagnosed with T2DM",
    "Blood glucose levels (% haemoglobin bound with glucose)",
    "Kidney function measured by blood creatinine levels (ml/min/1.73m2)",
    "Body mass index (kg/m2)",
    "High density lipoprotein cholesterol (mmol/L)",
    "Low density lipoprotein cholesterol (mmol/L)",
    "Systolic blood pressure (mmHg)",
    "Number of comorbidities (excluding T2DM)",
    "Number of concomitant medications (excluding those related to T2DM)"
  ),
  `Categories and limits` = c(
    "18 to 100 years", "Female, Male", 
    "Asian, Black/African American, White, Other",
    "No, Yes", "0.01 (<1 week) to 20 years", "6 to 10%",
    "60 to 120ml/min/1.73m2", "18 to 50kgm/2", "1 to 3mmol/L", "4 to 10mmol/L",
    "60 to 140mmHg", "0 to 10", "0 to 10"
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  conduct_inputs,
  align = c("l", "l", "l")
) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "bordered"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    fixed_thead = TRUE,
    font_size = 16,
    position = "left"
  )
```

### **Summary statistics**

**Box C** displays summary statistics for attrition risk over time. 

The following columns are generated in this summary table:

```{r echo = FALSE}
conduct_sum <- dplyr::tibble(
  Columns = c(
    "Follow-up time (weeks)", "Participants at risk",
    "Non-completers", "Attrition risk (%)"
  ),
  Description = c(
    "Each week of follow-up",
    "Number of participants at risk of attrition at a given week",
    "Number of non-completers at a given week",
    "The probability of attrition having occurred at a given week"
  )
)

knitr::kable(
  conduct_sum,
  align = c("l", "l")
) %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed", "bordered"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    font_size = 16,
    position = "left"
  )
```

### **Attrition risk over time**

**Box D** illustrates risk of attrition over time for a participant with certain characteristics in a trial with an inputted set of design features. The timeframe reflects the duration inputted in **Box A**. The y-axis illustrates risk of attrition (%), and the x-axis illustrates follow-up time in weeks.
